anchorAsk.text: Change of plan on the compound format. The deploy logs it's meant for get scraped by a Go service that runs every duration through `time.ParseDuration`, and that rejects spaces and has no `d` unit. So compound output has to be ParseDuration-compatible: parts glued together and hours as the biggest unit, e.g. `25h30m` rather than `1d 1h 30m`. Don't change it right now though, something more urgent first: `parse()` returns NaN when the value has surrounding whitespace (`' 2d'`, `'1.5h '`), and we get exactly that from YAML configs all the time. Make it tolerate leading and trailing whitespace.
